text:
jamie: Quick heads-up — discovered an auth-header regression that causes 502s for a subset of eu-edge embedding requests. PR #4876 merged to main. Need an expedited hotfix deploy to eu-edge pool, it's low-risk but customer-visible. Can we fast-track? :ambulance:
release_mgr: link the PR and release notes? will confirm impact and rollback plan.
jamie: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4876 — small header fix + unit test. Rollback = revert image tag, <5m. Release notes: patch line + CVE none.
sre_lead: Can we run a tiny canary (5%) for 10m? If Telemetry looks clean, greenlight for full. We should pin image tag to avoid autoscaler churn.
release_mgr: ack. I'll pin to image:redwood-hotfix-4876 and run canary. Need two approvers for expedite (ops + oncall).
alicem: +1 from product side, saw error spike in EU at 09:12 UTC.
ops-rotation: +1, oncall verified traceback looks like header parsing only. ops ready for manual rollout.
releasebot: Checklist: CHANGELOG ok, image built (image:redwood-hotfix-4876), tests passed, canary policy set. To proceed run: `./scripts/release deploy --env eu-edge --image redwood-hotfix-4876 --canary 5% --timeout 10m`
release_mgr: running command now. pasting output: ```
> ./scripts/release deploy --env eu-edge --image redwood-hotfix-4876 --canary 5% --timeout 10m
deploybot: job 8791 started — creating canary slice (5%). will report back on health checks.```
deploybot: canary slices up: 2 instances in eu-west1, health checks passing, avg p50 latency unchanged, error-rate reduced in canary group.
sre_lead: Observability looks good so far (10m window). No regressions in CPU/memory. Recommend promote.
release_mgr: promoting to 100% now. command: `./scripts/release promote --job 8791 --to 100%`
deploybot: promotion started, draining old pods, applying image:redwood-hotfix-4876 across eu-edge pool.
releasebot: deployment completed — all eu-edge instances on redwood-hotfix-4876. Post-deploy health: p50/p95 stable, error-rate down to baseline.
jamie: huge thanks everyone for the quick approvals and canary checks. filing release note and backport. :rocket:
ops-rotation: noted, I'll update oncall runbook and keep an eye for the next 30m.
release_mgr: closing ticket and marking hotfix as expedited. I'll note the rollback command in the ticket for completeness.
jamie: closing thread — resolved.
